product_metadata.title: SlipX Solutions Suction Double Soap Saver in White (Excellent Drainage, Holds 11 Pounds)
features: No Tools, No Drilling, Removable: Easy to install, suction cups with maximum grip. Simple to reposition. (Do not install directly over grout lines)
Strong Secure Fit: Holds up to 11 pounds, no need to worry about products that are too heavy.
Excellent Drainage: Innovative open design allows for easy water drainage and maximum ventilation. Removable trays are easy to clean.
Versatile Use: Perfect for holding different scented soaps, razers, or sponges.
Perfect for use between partners or roommates that use different soaps and razors in the shower.
To remove, simply place a straight edge of a butter knife or credit card behind the suction cup and remove. Rinse with warm water before repositioning.
